vo.en: Try this right now to glitch your brain. Cross your middle finger over your index finger.

vo.en: Now, close your eyes and rub the very tip of your nose between those two crossed fingers.

visual.description: A man with his eyes closed using his crossed fingers to feel the tip of his nose.

vo.en: Wait, it gets even creepier once your brain panics. Your mind cannot process these crossed touch points.

visual.description: Abstract digital glitch overlay moving rapidly across a dark background.

vo.en: Because your fingers are reversed, your sensory map breaks. You’ll feel two distinct noses under your fingertips.
